ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The longitude and latitude range of the region shown is roughly 44°N—52°N, 92°E—116°E, located in the mid-latitude inland region of the Eurasian continent; in the figure there are precipitation contour lines such as 100, 200, and 300, and overall it shows the distribution characteristics of relatively little inland precipitation and changes from locally wetter areas toward the surroundings. Reasoning: The question asks about the type of natural zone on the “eastern side of the continent at the same latitude as the region shown,” not the natural zone of the shown inland region itself. Moving along the same latitude toward the eastern coast or eastern side of the Eurasian continent, this area is affected by monsoons and ocean water vapor, and its moisture conditions are better than those inland. It belongs to a temperate relatively humid region, and the corresponding typical natural zone is the temperate deciduous broad-leaved forest zone.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图示范围在约44°N—52°N、92°E—116°E，位于亚欧大陆中纬度内陆，图内有100、200、300等降水量等值线。再读题意，题目问的是“图示区域同纬度的大陆东侧”而不是图示内陆本身。根据相同纬度向大陆东部沿海/东侧迁移，判断为亚欧大陆东部温带地区；该处受季风和海洋影响较湿润，对应自然带为温带落叶阔叶林带。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图示区域的经纬度范围大致为44°N—52°N、92°E—116°E，位于亚欧大陆中纬度内陆地区；图中有100、200、300等降水量等值线，整体显示内陆降水较少、由局部较湿区向周边变化的分布特征。推理：题目问的是“图示区域同纬度的大陆东侧”的自然带类型，而不是图示内陆本身的自然带。沿相同纬度向亚欧大陆东部沿海或东侧移动，该地区受季风和海洋水汽影响，水分条件比内陆更好，属于温带较湿润地区，对应的典型自然带为温带落叶阔叶林带。
